claim_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.
metric_name: Fatalities from health and safety incidents
context_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.；Tragically, we experienced a fatality within our business this year.；Health and safety performance FY25: Fatalities from health and safety incidents 1.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告同页及相邻页明确披露FY25发生1起致命事故，与“everyone can go home safe and well”这一结果性、绝对化表述直接冲突。
notes: 典型安全类绝对化宣传语。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company’s ‘safety guarantee’ instils a belief that everyone can go home safe and well (i.e., that people can go home safe and well as a practical outcome). The provided evidence instead states that there was a fatality in the business this year and reports “Fatalities from health and safety incidents 1” for FY25. This does not substantively verify that everyone can go home safe and well; it materially undermines that outcome-based implication, and no evidence is provided showing the guarantee’s effectiveness or results beyond the reported fatality.
